project.name: agent-cast
project.objective: Build an effect-aware execution optimizer backed by actor-owned resources; preserve logical authority and effects while reducing measured physical work.
project.scope: Foundation first; no production permissions, broker, isolation or performance claim yet.

routing_policy.context: Short task briefs and explicit source allowlists; no full-history forks
routing_policy.repair_policy: At most two repair rounds per delegated scope before parent review
routing_policy.usage_policy: Null means unavailable; actual token counts require a provider receipt. No inferred totals.
routing_policy.current_batch: M3 actual broker and Python/Node clients in parallel;62 tests and13 embedded CLI checks passed; draft CI checkpoint next

milestones.title: Program setup and reproducible toolchain
acceptance: Canonical task ledger validates; milestone/task IDs and dependencies are stable
Task-scoped Zig 0.16.0 matches repository CI and published archive SHA256
Compact model assignments, file ownership, and verification gates recorded

milestones.title: Typed planner and embedded immutable-reader proof
acceptance: Per-logical identity and exact fixture admissions survive optimized grouping
Real bytes are captured once; enabled and disabled modes return equal full outputs
Denied/stale calls receive no data; unsupported execution is rejected
Build, focused tests, and built prototype interaction have successful receipts; CI remains separately gated

milestones.title: Bounded shared observation cache
acceptance: Successful certified immutable values are reusable by separately admitted agents in one compatible task/domain
Different task/domain/view/contract cannot reuse a result; current authority checked on hits
Owned cache memory, entry/byte limits, eviction, and truthful provenance verified

milestones.title: Broker, Python and Node clients
acceptance: Framed control/data, negotiated limits, logical IDs and backing work IDs interoperable
Two actual clients share eligible values; deadlines, cancellation and byte credits are independent
Exact host authority and resource generations rechecked before dispatch

milestones.title: Supervised workers and recovery
acceptance: Worker loss replaces epoch, invalidates old handles, and retains settled/unknown receipts
Queued versus running versus committed cancellation classifications survive faults
Unknown effects are reconciled rather than automatically repeated; restart and memory budgets enforced

milestones.title: libfx and harness integration
acceptance: A deterministic provider fixture drives an actual libfx tool interaction and result publication
Schemas/outputs, host authority, output-drain and SDK cancellation semantics preserved
Native terminal/file-mutation migration remains separately reviewed; exact-commit product CI gates pass

milestones.title: Clean isolated eval tasks
acceptance: One existing Linux backend creates independent state from pinned images/fixtures
Full containment cleanup, routes/credentials revocation, reset probes and quarantine verified
Independent terminal-state grading detects required, missing and extra effects

milestones.title: Scoped service clients and measured strategy
acceptance: Pooled HTTP requests still execute every required application request
Pool partitions and credential/config generation changes are tested; database work requires its own reset contract
Cost model includes planning, guards, hashing, fan-out, useful work, output and persistence; valid native fallback tested

milestones.title: Comparative qualification and release decision
acceptance: Compare exact fixed traces and full repeated trials against optimized native/persistent/warm baselines
Equal results/errors/audit/authority/effects under equal complete resource budgets
Publish only measured claims and require exact-commit CI plus local happy path and ship gate

tasks.title: Freeze scope, milestones and model-routing policy
acceptance: Milestones have gates and dependencies; each task has a bounded owner and scope
Model assignments agree with available tools; unknown usage remains null

tasks.title: Implement and validate the read-only task-ledger CLI
acceptance: Actual ledger validates; next/show preserve status and ownership
Malformed fields, cycles, missing dependencies, and unproven completion fail with useful errors
Checker does not present ledger status as live CI or ship verification
tasks.integration_note: Luna authored the checker and one bounded repair; coordinator added CLI tests and repaired malformed milestone/schema-version handling.

tasks.title: Provision pinned toolchain and record receipt
acceptance: Zig 0.16.0 binary runs; archive hash equals published SHA256
No global toolchain/environment changes; one build job at a time

tasks.title: Implement typed exact-binding and immutable grouping contracts
acceptance: Preserve every logical call and exclude denied/stale/mismatched consumers
Share only compatible certified immutable reads; different domains/tasks/options/contracts remain separate
Borrowed data remains alive and immutable; bounded allocation and duplicate-ID rejection tested

tasks.title: Implement frozen-content executor and actual demo binary
acceptance: Capture real file bytes once, execute known reader only, and preserve full logical outputs
Enabled/disabled parity includes denied/stale consumers, window bounds, contract and output-budget checks
Built demo uses input identity and actual executor counts; labels two logical agents without claiming multi-process execution

tasks.title: Review authority, ownership and equivalence boundaries
acceptance: Review exact-binding fields, denied consumers, immutable proof and mutable borrowed backing
Fix material findings before local proof; record remaining production gaps

tasks.title: Run focused tests and real enabled/disabled interactions
acceptance: Format/build/focused tests pass under pinned toolchain
Personally run built binary against actual fixture and compare full result hashes and counts
Stderr clean, no abort; source/binary hashes and exit receipts retained; no speed claim

tasks.title: Prepare checkpoint and exact-commit CI qualification
acceptance: Focused proof and built happy path precede any external publication
Require exact current commit CI including macOS and prototype qualification before any ready claim
Record absent publication authorization or unavailable checks; do not invent a successful gate
tasks.pending_reason: Fork publication route now available; draft PR and exact-commit CI pending.

tasks.title: Add owned bounded completed-value cache
acceptance: Cache successful immutable canonical values after each current logical admission
Prove two-agent sharing, domain/task isolation, invalidation, eviction and output lifetime

tasks.title: Qualify inflight sharing and independent consumers
acceptance: Cancel one subscriber without stopping work required by another
Keep independent deadlines/credits/audit/retry provenance; reject stale result delivery
tasks.pending_reason: Thirteen subscriber unit tests pass; actual shared producer/cancellation runtime interaction remains pending broker composition.

tasks.title: Implement framed local broker and scoped enrollment
acceptance: Bounds, framing, epochs, roles, authority and reconnect semantics tested
Two actual clients exercise shared state; same-UID process is not advertised as containment
tasks.implementation_note: Registry/framing contracts compile and pass tests; actual async broker implementation has begun with strict control FD, acknowledged output and generation-scoped cache.

tasks.title: Add Python and Node adapters
acceptance: Identical operation contract and ordinary results across both languages
Credits, interrupt, reconnect/status and cleanup work against real broker
tasks.pending_reason: Clients are being implemented against locked broker DTOs; actual broker interoperability is pending.

tasks.title: Supervise isolated worker lifetimes and uncertainty
acceptance: Inject pre-start, inflight, after-effect and before-publication failures
No duplicated uncertain mutation; bounded restart, drain and teardown

tasks.title: Connect a fixture-driven libfx host tool
acceptance: Actual tool call travels libfx to broker and returns its result
Preserve host authority/cancellation and document absent stable SDK recovery identity

tasks.title: Qualify one existing Linux isolation backend
acceptance: Fresh workspace/worker/backend state per trial; cleanup prevents surviving writers
Grader stays outside execution service; failed resets quarantined

tasks.title: Add scoped pooled HTTP owner and cost attribution
acceptance: Retain client setup but perform all required requests
Credential/config partitions, drain, request accounting and full costs verified

tasks.title: Qualify fixed traces and repeated agent outcomes
acceptance: Meaningful optimized baselines, equal work/resources, and independent outcomes
Exact-commit gates and local happy path verified; report failed/uncertain results
Independent adversarial scenarios include deliberate broken/featureless controls that must fail qualification.

tasks.title: Independently red-team and close material runtime findings
acceptance: Exercise real built runtime adversarial authority, cache, framing, cancellation, recovery, reset and service-generation paths.
Independently compare required and extra effects; qualification rejects deliberate broken controls.
Every material finding is repaired and affected checks are rerun; unresolved findings block promotion.
tasks.implementation_note: Early helper-oracle negative controls pass; full runtime red-team matrix remains planned.

goal.objective: Implement M2 through M8 and independently red-team validate the full bounded agent-cast system.
goal.execution: Overnight goal loop; honor operator stops; one heavy job per host; preserve existing data and failed receipts.
goal.completion_rule: All milestone acceptance and independent adversarial checks supported by current receipts; exact-commit CI and applicable ship gate remain mandatory.
